basics.name: Jordan Rivera
basics.label: Staff Software Engineer, Platform · Kubernetes, Terraform, Go
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer, 9 years across fintech, logistics, and consulting work, focused on platform engineering and reliability. Built Acme Pay's first shared deploy platform and moved 40+ services from 6 teams onto it, cutting deploy lead time from ~3 days to under an hour. Writes the design doc, gets it through review, and mentors the engineers who build on it, targeting Staff IC scope.

highlights: Built Acme Pay's first shared deploy platform (Go, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions) and moved 40+ services from 6 teams onto it, cutting deploy lead time from ~3 days to under an hour.
Built the payments observability stack (SLOs, OpenTelemetry tracing, runbooks), bringing Sev-1 incidents from 14 to 5 a quarter and recovery time under 20 minutes.
Cut AWS compute spend ~35% by right-sizing services, adding autoscaling, and moving batch jobs to spot capacity.
Cut payments-API p99 latency ~60% at ~1.2M transactions a day. Mentors 3–4 engineers and runs the weekly design review.
Built the order-routing service from scratch in Go, replacing a Python cron job with an event-driven Kafka consumer and tripling peak throughput.
Improved developer experience by cutting the CI pipeline from 41 to 14 minutes with parallel tests, build caching, and a flaky-test quarantine.
Built backend APIs for 6 client projects in Python and PostgreSQL, including a retail inventory sync that went to production at 40 stores.
